_help: What a place's systems are when it has no file of its own in this folder, the numbers every place starts from, and what each kind of part looks like and how it can be worked by hand. A place's own file can change the numbers. _how-to-write-systems.txt explains it all. Restart the game after changing this file.

numbers: how many minutes the alarm rings before it stops by itself; how many minutes a room's air takes to go bad once it stops moving, and to come back once it moves again; how many hours the place's engineers take to fix something broken; and how many hours before the place's people switch back what the player switched off. thin and bad are how good the air is (out of 100) when it starts to hurt, and how much stress and health it costs each 10 minutes.
dark and watched are what a dark room and a camera on the player do to their checks. seen is what being seen tampering costs with whoever holds the place.

open air are the places where the air needs no machine; no systems are the places whose machinery isn't wired the way anyone's is; cameras everywhere are the places with a camera in every room. guard words and engineer words find the guards and engineers in the people's days, when a place's file doesn't name them.

parts: each kind of part, by its name in the files, with other names it can go by. look is what the player reads, and on, off and damaged are what's added for its state. switch is a switch the player can work by hand, break is tampering with it, which takes a check, and fix is putting it right; tampering where a camera can see raises the alarm. A part whose name isn't here behaves like the first part of its system.

junction box.look: A grey box on the wall, with a hazard stripe and a heavy lever.
junction box.on: It hums, and the rooms it feeds have power.
junction box.off: Its lever is down, and the rooms it feeds are dead.
junction box.damaged: Its cables are cut, and it's dead.

break.label: Cut the cables
break.done: The cables part with a crack and a smell of burnt plastic, and everything it feeds goes dead.
break.failed: The cables are thicker than they looked, and nothing gives.

fix.label: Splice the cables back together
fix.done: The splice holds, and the box hums again.
fix.failed: The splice won't take. It needs another go, or someone who does this for a living.

air plant.look: A machine the size of a cupboard, breathing for everyone, with ducts running out of it into the walls.
air plant.off: It's been shut down, and nothing's moving in the ducts.
air plant.damaged: Its intake is jammed, and it's straining against nothing.

break.label: Jam the intake
break.done: The intake chokes on what you've fed it, and the fans wind down.
break.failed: The intake spits it back out. It's built for worse than you.

fix.label: Clear the intake
fix.done: The intake clears, and the fans spin up.
fix.failed: Whatever's in the intake is wedged too deep for now.

vent.look: A vent grille in the wall, where the room's air comes in.
vent.off: It's been closed from somewhere else.

break.label: Seal the vent
break.done: You seal it over. The room goes very quiet, the way a room does when the air stops.
break.failed: The seal won't sit flat, and the air pushes it off.

fix.label: Pull the seal off
fix.done: The seal comes away, and the air comes back in.

light switch.look: A switch for the room's lights, by the wall.

camera.look: A camera high on the wall, with a red light and a lens on the room.
camera.on: Its red light is on. It's watching.

break.label: Cover the lens
break.done: You get a rag over the lens without it getting a look at you.
break.failed: You're too slow. The lens turns, and gets a good look at you.

fix.label: Uncover the lens
fix.done: The rag comes off, and the lens is on the room again.

speaker.look: An alarm speaker on the wall, a round grille with a red lamp in the middle.

break.label: Cut its wires
break.done: The wires part. Whatever happens now, this room won't hear about it.
break.failed: The wires are behind a plate you can't get off.

fix.label: Rewire it
fix.done: It crackles, and it's working again.
fix.failed: You can't get the wires to meet.

relay.look: A comms relay, a rack of boards with a light for every channel.
relay.on: Its lights are green. Calls are going in and out.
relay.off: It's been switched off, and nobody's calling anyone.
relay.damaged: It's jammed, and every channel is noise.

break.label: Jam the relay
break.done: Every light goes amber, and every channel fills with noise.
break.failed: It reroutes around whatever you do faster than you can do it.

fix.label: Clear it
fix.done: The channels clear one by one.

engines.look: The drive's housing, too hot to touch, with the injector bank behind a grating.
engines.damaged: An injector's missing, and it won't light.

break.label: Pull an injector
break.done: The injector comes out hot. Nothing's jumping anywhere until it goes back in.
break.failed: The grating's locked, and the heat drives you back.

fix.label: Refit the injector
fix.done: It seats with a clunk, and the drive comes back.

nav core.look: The navigation core, a stack of old boards that plot every jump.

break.label: Scramble the alignment
break.done: The alignment drifts out of true. Every jump will be plotted by hand until someone fixes it.
break.failed: It corrects itself as fast as you can push it.

fix.label: Realign it
fix.failed: It won't hold its alignment yet.

docking clamps.look: The docking clamps' control, a heavy lever behind a cage.
docking clamps.on: The clamps are released, and ships come and go.
docking clamps.off: The clamps are locked, and nobody's leaving.

machine.look: A machine on the wall, doing whatever it does.

break.label: Break it
break.done: Something inside gives, and it stops.

doors.locked: It's locked, and the panel beside it is red.
doors.forced: It's been forced, and it won't lock any more.

force.label: Force the door
force.done: The door gives, and stays open. It won't lock again until someone fixes it.
